list(APPEND linalg_sources

    # vector_dot_impl.cc          # Template issues - needs refactor

    vector_outer_product_impl.cc         # New: Vector outer product (tensor product)
    matrix_condition_number_impl.cc      # New: Matrix condition number for stability analysis
    matrix_norm_impl.cc                  # New: Matrix norm computation (L1, L2, Frobenius, Max)
    matrix_reshape_impl.cc               # Phase 3: Matrix reshape operation for data manipulation
    matrix_solve_impl.cc                 # Phase 3: Linear system solver (Ax = b)
    performance_profiler.cc              # New: Performance profiling infrastructure
)

set(linalg_sources
    "${linalg_sources}"
    PARENT_SCOPE)
if(NOT linalg_sources)
    message(STATUS "No C++ sources... skipping lib/")
    return()
endif(NOT linalg_sources)

add_library(gnuradio-linalg SHARED ${linalg_sources}
    matrix_source_const_impl.cc
    matrix_hermitian_impl.cc
    matrix_diag_impl.cc
    matrix_pseudo_inverse_impl.cc  # Simplified inheritance following matrix_diag pattern
    matrix_exp_impl.cc               # Restored: matrix exponential implementation
    decomp_schur_impl.cc         # Restored: Real and Complex Schur decomposition implementation
    decomp_hessenberg_impl.cc   # Hessenberg decomposition implementation
    vector_angle_impl.cc        # Vector angle computation implementation
    vector_projection_impl.cc   # Vector projection computation implementation
    vector_product_inner_impl.cc    # Restored: vector inner product (dot product) implementation
    vector_product_outer_impl.cc   # Restored: vector outer product implementation
    solve_triangular_impl.cc       # Re-enabled: refactored to modern linalg_base framework
    solve_least_squares_impl.cc    # Fixed: refactored to modern linalg_base framework
    solve_iterative_impl.cc        # New: Iterative linear system solvers (CG, BiCGStab, GMRES, LSCG)
    vector_to_matrix_impl.cc       # Fixed: refactored to modern linalg_base framework
    vector_correlate_impl.cc       # Restored: vector correlation implementation
    array_slice_impl.cc            # Array slicing - inline 1D implementation
    matrix_pseudo_determinant_impl.cc   # Matrix pseudo-determinant implementation
    matrix_log_impl.cc                  # Matrix logarithm implementation
    matrix_sqrt_impl.cc                 # Matrix square root implementation (different from Cholesky)
    matrix_trig_impl.cc                 # Matrix trigonometric functions (sin, cos, tan)
    # matrix_covariance_impl.cc           # Statistical covariance matrix computation - temporarily disabled
    # matrix_correlation_impl.cc          # Statistical correlation matrix computation (Pearson, Spearman, Kendall) - temporarily disabled
    matrix_eigenvalues_impl.cc          # Matrix eigenvalues extraction (efficient eigenvalue-only computation)
)
target_link_libraries(gnuradio-linalg gnuradio::gnuradio-runtime)
target_include_directories(
    gnuradio-linalg
    PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include>
    PUBLIC $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>)
set_target_properties(gnuradio-linalg PROPERTIES DEFINE_SYMBOL "gnuradio_linalg_EXPORTS")

if(APPLE)
    set_target_properties(gnuradio-linalg PROPERTIES INSTALL_NAME_DIR
                                                    "${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/lib")
endif(APPLE)

########################################################################
# Install built library files
########################################################################
include(GrMiscUtils)
gr_library_foo(gnuradio-linalg)

########################################################################
# Print summary
########################################################################
message(STATUS "Using install prefix: ${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}")
message(STATUS "Building for version: ${VERSION} / ${LIBVER}")

foreach(qa_file ${test_linalg_sources})
    get_filename_component(qa_name ${qa_file} NAME_WE)
    gr_add_cpp_test("linalg_${qa_name}.cc" ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${qa_file})
